description.full_text: The image features a cute, cartoon-like character, resembling a bear or mouse, with pink cheeks. It is joyfully holding a frothy mug of beer. Above the character, the text "恭喜恭喜" (meaning "congratulations") is displayed in stylized font. The atmosphere is celebratory and cheerful.
